 Tesla Malaysia introduces pre-owned programme, certified vehicles from RM135k
 By Jun - Nov 21, 2026 11:46 am 
 Tesla has introduced its Certified Pre-Owned Programme in Malaysia, giving prospective buyers a more accessible entry point to the brand.
 Under the programme, vehicles sold here are inspected and refurbished by Tesla-qualified technicians using official parts to ensure they are road-ready.
 These assessments consist of a 102-point inspection covering the car’s mechanical condition, safety systems, and functionalities, alongside its interior and exterior cosmetic condition.
 Depending on the selected vehicle and availability, the pre-owned Tesla comes with either Basic Autopilot or Enhanced Autopilot.
 All Certified Pre-Owned Tesla vehicles are covered by the remainder of their original New Vehicle Limited Warranty, alongside an additional one-year or 20,000 km warranty, whichever comes first.
 Interested customers can browse the official Tesla Malaysia website linked here for the latest inventory, with selected vehicles starting from RM135,000 .
